items.t: Strathcona is the name of both an MLS sub-area and a City neighbourhood; the City describes it as a historic neighbourhood east of Chinatown.
Chinatown's HA-1 and HA-1A heritage zoning applies to the area bounded by Hastings, Union, Gore and Carrall streets, with Pender Street as its historic core.

Strathcona's character-protection zoning is the RT-3 district schedule, whose stated intent is to keep neighbourhood and streetscape character, mainly by retaining and renovating character buildings, and which refers to pre-1920 architecture.
Under RT-3, converting a building to up to two units without exterior change is outright; infill, multiple dwellings and many other uses are conditional approvals decided by the Director of Planning.
The R1-1 zone replaced former RS zones in 2023; RT-3 is a separate district schedule, so R1-1 multiplex rules should not be assumed for RT-3 lots.
The guidelines were last amended July 9, 2024.

faq.q: What did condos in Strathcona sell for?
faq.a: The median condo sale in Strathcona was $620,000, across 42 sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Strathcona?
faq.a: Typical time on the market was 20 days. At the median, sale prices were 97.1% of list, and 12% of sales closed above list (November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Strathcona sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 42 condos that sold in Strathcona went for between $527,500 and $780,000, around a median of $620,000.

faq.q: Do condos in Strathcona sell above asking price?
faq.a: 12% of the 42 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.1% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Strathcona?
faq.a: Of the 42 sales, 42 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $408.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Strathcona?
faq.a: The median year built was 2010 for the 42 condos sold in Strathcona.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Strathcona usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Strathcona had 1 bedroom, from the 42 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
